observations.note: 'Do not invent an identifier for the unlabeled Codex leftover-join.v15 MUST-FIX.' This is the subject's only fully unstemmed prose leftover-join version token; every other prose lineage token leads with its stem. New at v17 - v16's purpose said 'the unlabeled Codex MUST-FIX' with no version at all. Not a finding, on three independent grounds. (1) D-294 Decision clause 1 scopes the citation convention to currency-asserting sentences with a lineage stem immediately before 'leftover-join', and expressly treats an unstemmed token as 'a direction example, not a counted site'; this sentence asserts no currency at all, it is a scope denial. (2) It resolves uniquely inside the artifact: $.basedOn.predecessorV15.reviews.codex.verdict is the only unlabeled Codex MUST-FIX the subject carries, and $.findingDisposition.codexV15MustFixD323Commit binds it. (3) Corpus practice is settled against treating this as a defect - 71 of 270 non-review leftover-join artifacts carry fully unstemmed prose tokens, including doctor-actor leftover-join.v12, which is recorded (D-285), dual ACCEPT 0/0, and current, and which carries 63 of them in currency-asserting sentences.
